_comment: Hand-curated seed catalog. The COMPREHENSIVE set of work-zone (WZDx) feeds
is discovered at runtime from the live USDOT WZDx Feed Registry via
`freetraffic sources discover-wzdx`. This file carries what discovery can't
find: Open511 event feeds, the shared IBI511/Travel-IQ vendor-platform
feeds (one API shape across many states), and live-speed feeds.
Adding a jurisdiction that speaks open511/wzdx/ibi511 is a pure data change.
Feeds with an api_key_env need that environment variable set before they run.
IBI511 URLs on state-branded domains are verified where noted; a few use the
vendor `*.ibi511.com` host or are marked 'verify' -- failures are isolated
per-feed, so an unreachable entry never sinks a run.

feeds.name: 511 SF Bay (MTC) - Open511 Traffic Events
feeds.notes: Reference Open511 deployment. Free token: https://511.org/open-data/token

feeds.name: 511NY - Traffic Speeds
feeds.notes: Live link speeds (the scarce signal). Same key as ibi511-ny-events.

feeds.name: UDOT Traffic (Utah) - Events
feeds.notes: IBI511/Travel-IQ (prod-ut.ibi511.com). Verify base URL on register.

feeds.name: FL511 (Florida) - Events
feeds.notes: IBI511/Travel-IQ. Verify base URL when registering at fl511.com.

feeds.name: New England 511 (NH/ME/VT tri-state) - Events
feeds.notes: Tri-state IBI511/Travel-IQ deployment (NH, ME, VT). Verify base URL.

feeds.name: 511IA (Iowa) - Events
feeds.notes: Candidate IBI511 deployment -- verify the base URL + that it's Travel-IQ, then enable. Open-network session: confirm at 511ia.org/developers.

feeds.name: 511 Nebraska - Events
feeds.notes: Candidate IBI511 deployment -- verify base URL then enable.

feeds.name: National Weather Service - Active Alerts (driving-relevant)
feeds.notes: Free, national, ungated weather alerts (winter/ice/fog/flood/wind/storm) -> WEATHER_CONDITION events. Filter by area with params, e.g. {"area": "WA"}.

feeds.name: WSDOT - Travel Times (measured current vs typical)
feeds.notes: Direct measured travel times -> LinkSpeed (current speed + freeflow baseline). Free key: https://wsdot.wa.gov/traffic/api/ . Template for other DOT travel-time feeds.

feeds.name: WSDOT - Traffic Flow (categorical sensor congestion)
feeds.notes: FlowReadingValue is a 0-4 congestion category, not a speed; needs a bespoke parser (roadmap). Prefer wsdot-travel-times for actual speeds.

feeds.name: Caltrans PeMS - Detector Station Speeds
feeds.notes: Loop-detector speeds/flow. Requires account + custom export parser (roadmap). One of the few true free live-speed sources in the US.

feeds.name: CBP - Land Border Wait Times
feeds.notes: Free, ungated, XML. Per-port wait minutes -> RESTRICTION events (no coordinates in the feed; a port->lon/lat lookup is a roadmap item).

feeds.name: NCDOT DriveNC - Incidents
feeds.notes: DriveNC public REST. Verify the endpoint/params on the open-network machine, then enable.

feeds.name: OHGO (Ohio DOT) - Construction
feeds.notes: Needs an API key. OHGO expects header 'Authorization: APIKEY <key>' -- set FT_OHGO_API_KEY to the full 'APIKEY <key>' value. Free key: https://publicapi.ohgo.com/

feeds.name: ArcGIS FeatureServer (template -- point at a real city/county layer)
feeds.notes: Generic ArcGIS REST adapter. Copy this entry, set url to a real FeatureServer query layer, prefer f=geojson. Handles Esri JSON + GeoJSON and Web-Mercator.

feeds.name: Socrata open-data (template -- point at a real city/county dataset)
feeds.notes: Generic Socrata (SODA) adapter. Copy this entry and set url to a real resource. Heuristic field detection + Socrata point/location geo.
